title: WoodCutter
description: Bring the power of the Stonecutter to wood! Cut planks into stairs, slabs, trapdoors, and fences with a perfect 1:1 ratio and zero lag.
body:
# 🪓 WoodCutter

**WoodCutter** is a lightweight, performance-friendly **Vanilla+ plugin** that brings the utility of the Stonecutter to the world of woodworking! 

Tired of wasting precious wood planks just to craft a few stairs or trapdoors? With this plugin, you can place any type of wood planks inside a standard Stonecutter and instantly cut them into slabs, stairs, trapdoors, fences, and more—with a perfect 1:1 resource ratio.

---

## ✨ Why choose WoodCutter?

* **📦 Pure Vanilla Experience:** No custom resource packs, no texture packs, and no commands needed. It uses the native Minecraft Stonecutter interface!
* **🛠️ Ultimate Builder Companion:** Save massive amounts of resources. Craft trapdoors, doors, and fences without the frustrating waste of the standard crafting table.
* **🌳 Full Wood Support:** Works with every wood type in the game, including Overworld woods, Nether woods (Crimson/Warped), Cherry, and Bamboo!
* **⚡ Zero Server Lag:** Built entirely using native Spigot/Paper recipe APIs. It takes 0ms of server tick time, making it 100% safe for large survival servers.

---

## 🚀 How to Use

1. Craft or place a standard **Stonecutter**.
2. Put any type of **Wood Planks** in the input slot.
3. Select your desired shape (Stairs, Slab, Trapdoor, etc.) and collect your blocks!

---

## 🔧 Installation & Compatibility

* **Drop & Play:** Just place the `WoodCutter.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder and restart/reload.
* **Supported Platforms:** Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and any other Spigot-based fork.
* **Smart Version Control:** Safe to use across multiple Minecraft versions. If a newer wood type (like Cherry) doesn't exist on an older server version, the plugin automatically skips it without throwing errors in the console.
